intent: Trace the child mortality percentage in Ethiopia from 1990 to 2019 to determine the overall trend.

requirements.question: How does the video present the required area marks in this chart?
Determine the overall trend of child mortality percentage in Ethiopia from 1990 to 2019.

units.claim: All 1 required area marks are present in the chart: child mortality.
accept: every listed area, reference mark, segment, or category is visible
each mark is correctly bound to its entity or series identity
reject: missing any required area, reference mark, segment, or category
assigning a mark to the wrong entity, panel, or series
replacing a required mark with narration text alone

units.claim: Child mortality percentage in Ethiopia decreased monotonically from 20.0% in 1990 to 7.0% in 2019.
accept: Child mortality declined steadily from 1990 to 2019.
The percentage fell from 20.0% to 7.0% over the period.
There is a sustained downward trend across the entire time span.
reject: Child mortality increased over the period.
The trend is flat or shows no clear direction.
The decline occurred only in part of the period.

optional_valid: The decline was continuous with no reversals in the sampled data.
The value in 2019 (7.0%) is the minimum in the dataset.
The value in 1990 (20.0%) is the maximum in the dataset.
unsupported_to_avoid: Child mortality in Ethiopia is the lowest in the world.
The rate of decline was constant over time.
The chart shows multiple countries or series.
review_notes: The intent asks only for the overall trend, so a single trend unit suffices.
The monotonic decrease is supported by the full sampled sequence, but basis rows use only endpoints per the rule that one unit needs at least two independent observations.
